In a situation where the club was facing financial restrictions, efforts were made and part of the route was opened.

But I believe that in the season of transfers, the courage to make a decision is more important than financial resources.

Building a new independence requires not only funds, but also intentions and courage.

Respect each other's expertise.

Step by step, quietly but firmly, we are building the future.
